% One page pair per morph case that tests/check_morph.py inspects mid-morph.
\documentclass{beamer}
\usepackage{kinema}
\setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{}

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}{Ring}
	\begin{tikzpicture}
		\useasboundingbox (-2,-2) rectangle (6,2);
		\begin{scope}[morph=ring]
			\only<1>{\fill[blue, even odd rule] (0,0) circle (1) (0,0) circle (0.5);}
			\only<2>{\fill[blue, even odd rule] (3,0) circle (1.5) (3,0) circle (0.7);}
		\end{scope}
	\end{tikzpicture}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Open curve}
	\begin{tikzpicture}
		\useasboundingbox (-2,-2) rectangle (6,2);
		\begin{scope}[morph=curve]
			\only<1>{\draw[line width=2pt] (0,0) .. controls (1,1.5) and (2,-1.5) .. (3,0);}
			\only<2>{\draw[line width=2pt] (0,1) .. controls (1,-1.5) and (2,1.5) .. (3,1);}
		\end{scope}
	\end{tikzpicture}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Label}
	\begin{tikzpicture}
		\useasboundingbox (-2,-2) rectangle (6,2);
		\begin{scope}[morph=box]
			\only<1>{\draw (0,-0.5) rectangle (2,0.5);}
			\only<2>{\draw (0,-0.5) rectangle (4,0.5);}
			\node at (1,0) {label};
		\end{scope}
	\end{tikzpicture}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
